title: Geometric flows of branched transportation networks
summary: The branched transport problem is a nonconvex and nonsmooth variational optimization problem on normal $1$-currents in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with prescribed boundary. The optimality is with respect to some non-decreasing, lower semicontinuous, and subadditive function $τ:\mathbb{R}_+\to\mathbb{R}_+$ with $τ(0)=0$ describing the cost $τ(m)$ to move an amount of mass $m$ per unit distance. The subadditivity leads to complicated, hierarchically ramified patterns in the support of (suboptimal) solutions.
